exposure: pre-existing hypertension with and without pre-eclampsia
low first-trimester pregnancy-associated plasma protein A
one or two or more previous caesarean section(s)
finding: Several maternal characteristics and serum biomarkers were associated with increased risk of PTB in both spontaneous and medically indicated subtypes.
mod_finding: The study found that previous cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of all subtypes of preterm birth.
